newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline differentials firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline differentials firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials firmed in thin trade early Monday, leaving gasoline prices steady against easing futures prices, traders said.
Traders said discussion was quiet but there was some activity in late-December deliveries in Group Three and January barrels in Chicago.
"Everything is pretty much holding steady, with some firmness in gas," one Chicago-area trader said. "The market should be slow into the middle of next week."
Group Three unleaded for late-December deliveries was bid 3.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX January unleaded, which fell more than 0.25 cent a gallon in morning trade.
Chicago unleaded was talked 3.50/3.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded for first-cycle deliveries and 0.50 cent a gallon weaker for later deliveries, traders said.
Diesel differentials were steady in both the Group Three and Chicago markets, and jet/kero was talked unchanged against steady NYMEX heating oil prices in morning trade.
